'''Klaus Buchner''' (born 6 February 1941) is a German [[university professor]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www-m10.ma.tum.de/bin/view/Lehrstuhl/KlausBuchner|title=Prof Dr Klaus Buchner|publisher=Technische Universität München|access-date=2018-07-06|archive-date=2016-12-15|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161215105720/http://www-m10.ma.tum.de/bin/view/Lehrstuhl/KlausBuchner|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[physicist]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://klaus-buchner.eu/vita/ |title=Vita |access-date=2018-07-06 |archive-date=2019-06-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190623191842/https://klaus-buchner.eu/vita/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and former [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] for the [[Green conservatism|green-conservative]] [[Ecological Democratic Party]] (ÖDP).<ref>[https://www.oedp-bayern.de/partei/mandatstraeger/ Mandatstraeger, ÖDP]</ref> He represented the [[European Parliament]] [[Germany (European Parliament constituency)|Germany constituency]] from [[2014 European Parliament election|2014]] until July 2020, and sat with the [[Greens–European Free Alliance]] group in the [[European Parliament]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europarl.europa.eu/meps/en/124818/KLAUS_BUCHNER_home.html|title=Klaus Buchner|publisher=European Parliament}}</ref> He was Leader of the ÖDP from 2003 to 2010. Buchner is a fellow of the [[European Institute for International Law and International Relations]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=admin |date=2015-10-19 |title=Prof Dr Klaus Buchner (Distinguished Fellow) – Germany |url=https://www.eiir.eu/our-experts/prof-dr-klaus-buchner-distinguished-fellow-germany/ |access-date=2023-03-18 |website=The European Institute for International Law and International Relations |language=en-GB}}</ref>
